senses.gloss:
Konārkakṣetramāhātmya
on Konark in Orissa. IO. 6943 (mostly in Oriya with Skt. q.s). Mack. 68 (described a. in Skt. with Oriya gloss).

Koneradeva
patronised by Vijayasiṁhadeva of Seṅgaravaṁśa, chief of Yadupakara (?), south of the Vindhyas an. son of Gayandasiṁha; resident a. Kāśī, father of Rāmakṛṣṇa (a. of C. Saṁskāragaṇapati on Pāraskara's Kātīya gṛh. sūtra, IO. 358. 359. RASB. II. 1026).
C.. Koṇḍa Bhaṭṭa, father of Rāmakṛṣṇa (a. of Śrāddhasaṅgraha or Ś. gaṇapati written in 1751 A. D. a. Kāśī). Both were Kāṇvas.

Koneri
of Bhāradvājagotra; brother of Subrahmaṇya an. father of Jīva (a. of Nalānanda, TD. 4369). [Page094-a.

Koneri
father of Veṅkaṭayati (a. of Bhūgolaprakāśa, paur. Bikaner 1324).

Koneri
elder brother of Raṅganātha (a. of Bhedataraṅgiṇī, dvai. MT. 1298).

Koneri
of Śrīvatsagotra; saluted along with Viṭṭhala, a. authority in Śāstra an. Vaidya, by a. of Sāhityakaṇṭakoddhāra, MT. 2597.

Koneri
son an. pupil of Keśavācārya of Padmanābhakula.
--Smṛtibhūṣaṇa. Hpr. III. 358. PUL. I. p. 108.
See above p. 55b.

Koneripaṇḍita
son of Veṅkaṭeśācārya, elder brother of Rāma (a. of C. on Daśāvatārastava, GD. 1167B).
--Daśāvatārastava. GD. 1167A.

Koneribhaṭṭa
great grandson of Kṛṣṇa Bhaṭṭa (a of a C. on Carakasaṁhitā an. of Sāhityasudhāsamudra); son of Viṣṇu Bhaṭṭa; nephew of Nārāyaṇa Bhaṭṭa (a. of Oṁkāragrantha); father of Rudra Bhaṭṭa (a. of C. Dīpikā on Lolimbarāja's Vaidyajīvana, Bomb. Uni. 236. IO. 2688); court physician (?) of Khānkhān; said to have composed a voluminous work on medicine.
See Bomb. Uni. 236. NCC. III. p. 93b. IV. p. 361a.

Koneribhaṭṭa
of Vasiṣṭhagotra; son of Melagiri Ācārya, surnamed Kalyāṇaka.
--Āśaucanirṇaya.
See NCC. II. p. 204a.

Koneribhaṭṭa
--Tattvasaṅgraha. dh. BORI. 190 of 1886-92. Peters. IV. p. 7 (no. 190).

Konerisūri
--Rasaratnāvalī. alaṁk. Alph. List Beng. Govt. p. 96. [Page094-b]
